provider: Google Cloud Free Tier — Cloud Storage

free_tier.stated: 5 GB-months of regional storage per month (us-east1/us-west1/us-central1 only), 5,000 Class A ops, 50,000 Class B ops, 100 GB outbound/month from North America.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: '100 GB of outbound data transfer from North America to all region destinations (excluding China and Australia) per month'. Free, recurring monthly, applies to all GCP customers, not a trial.

tooling: GCS JSON/XML API, S3-compatible XML endpoint (rclone 'gcs' and 's3' with GCS provider); gsutil/gcloud storage; signed URLs for public reads.
chaining: 5 GB per billing account. Billing accounts are tied to a payment instrument, so account multiplication is not free/trivial. The real GCP lever is not this tier. It is the $300/90-day trial and the startup credits (below).
limits_note: Free tier includes 5 GB of standard storage in select US regions and 100 GB per month of outbound internet egress.

identity_cost.detail: Free Trial signup requires a credit card or other payment method, and in some countries bank account verification; the Free Tier limits are calculated per billing account.

reliability_note: Rock solid, no data loss or throttling surprises; the limit is purely quota size.
